recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, duotone portrait of a male figure with voluminous hair, rendered in deep amber and black tones. The composition is top-heavy with bold serif typography and features a detailed tracklist at the bottom, creating a classic 1970s-style live album aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: Amber highlights against a deep black void
Bold red-outlined display type against dark backgrounds
Vertical hierarchy from large title to small tracklist
Soft-focus photographic grain versus sharp typographic edges

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait occupying the central and lower-right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit forehead and hair of the subject acting as a central light source.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large red title at the top, moves down through the subject's face, and settles on the tracklist at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space in the upper-left and lower-left corners provides breathing room for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black serves as the foundation and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant amber/orange defines the subject and secondary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright red with yellow outlines for the primary display name.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the glowing amber skin tones and the absolute black shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses high-contrast thick/thin strokes
Secondary text uses italicized transitional serifs
Bottom metadata uses clean, legible serif faces
characterSpecificRedesigns: Primary name features a thin yellow outline to separate red fill from black background

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the dark background above the subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold display serif paired with elegant italicized body serif.
graphicDevices: Red bullet points as separators in the tracklist

preserve: Red/Yellow outline effect for main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classic, authoritative serif feel of the era.
Provides the elegant, calligraphic feel for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast duotone portrait of a man with 1970s wavy hair, looking down. Use an amber and black color palette with heavy grain. Ensure the top and bottom areas have deep black space for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large all-caps bold serif title in red with a thin yellow outline at the top. Below it, add a medium-sized italicized serif subtitle in amber. At the bottom, typeset a multi-line tracklist in a small white/amber serif font with red bullet separators.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly amber, black, red, and yellow?
Is the main title outlined in yellow?
Is the portrait high-contrast with deep shadows?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and track titles
Exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Verify duotone consistency across the image
Ensure the red text pops against the black background
Confirm the grain texture is visible but not distracting
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast duotone portrait + Bold outlined serif display type + Italicized serif subtitle + Bottom-aligned tracklist metadata.
